title: Independent car-detailing business-contact review
hypothesis: A published Maps number for an independent, core car-detailing business can begin a business-contact workflow. Neither a mobile-detailing claim, a Maps phone, nor an SOS agent/officer establishes business ownership, ownership of a handset, or permission to contact a person.
ownerSource: No owner-confirming detailing source is implemented. The catalog's SOS-plus-Maps suggestion supplies only a role-labeled agent or officer candidate after a business match and must not be used for personal-phone or address enrichment.
phoneSource: Implemented recipe-A Maps discovery for the car-detailing keyword; the published number remains a business-contact candidate until the existing line, live, DNC/TCPA, suppression, and duplicate gates pass.

workflow.label: Discover published car-detailing business
workflow.detail: Start with the live recipe-A Maps route. A listing and advertised number are business evidence only.

workflow.label: Core detailing fit?
workflow.detail: Require detailing, detail, ceramic coating, paint correction, or mobile-detailing evidence. Car wash, tint, wrap, and auto-repair-only results do not prove a detailing business.

workflow.label: Hold adjacent or ambiguous result
workflow.detail: Do not relabel a car wash, tint/wrap, repair shop, dealer, or generic automotive listing as detailing without core detailing evidence.

workflow.label: Independent operator segment?
workflow.detail: Keep franchise, chain, and multi-location listings out of the owner-candidate branch pending a separately reviewed workflow.

workflow.label: Hold brand or multi-location listing
workflow.detail: A branded local outlet can be a business contact but is not an owner-confirmed contact from its brand pattern.

workflow.label: Published business number present?
workflow.detail: Do not infer a person phone from a mobile-service claim, agent/officer name, business address, or a different public listing number.

workflow.label: Hold missing business contact
workflow.detail: Keep an identity candidate without a published business number out of phone processing.

workflow.label: Business-contact gates
workflow.detail: Require mobile classification, reachability, DNC/TCPA clearance, suppression, and duplicate checks on the published number. These do not prove ownership of the business or handset.

workflow.label: Hold failed contact gate
workflow.detail: Hold non-mobile, unreachable, DNC/TCPA, suppressed, duplicate, or otherwise unverified rows.

workflow.label: Independent owner and handset evidence?
workflow.detail: A matched SOS agent/officer, a business name, a mobile line, or a review mention alone is insufficient. Preserve any role as candidate evidence only.

workflow.label: Hold as business contact
workflow.detail: Do not label or deliver an owner-confirmed mobile without separately recorded ownership and handset evidence.

workflow.label: Deliver approved owner-confirmed contact
workflow.detail: Only a future workflow that records independent owner evidence and every contact/compliance gate may use this classification.

failures.risk: Car washes are admitted as core detailing because the detailing profile includes car wash in its core terms.
failures.mitigation: Move car wash from the detailing core list to adjacent (or remove it), then require a detail/ceramic/paint-correction/mobile-detailing signal before the car-detailing route continues.

failures.risk: Tint, wrap, PPF, auto-repair, dealer, or car-wash-only listings are described as detailing businesses.
failures.mitigation: Hold adjacent-only listings until a core detailing signal is present; do not treat the brain allow pattern as owner or relevance proof.

failures.risk: A mobile-detailing advertisement is described as a direct owner cell.
failures.mitigation: Treat the Maps number as a published business contact and retain mobile/service claims as unverified; require line, live, DNC/TCPA, suppression, dedupe, owner, and handset gates.

failures.risk: An SOS agent or officer is represented as the owner, or a filing address is used to find a personal phone.
failures.mitigation: Use any SOS role only as matched identity-candidate evidence, prohibit address/person-phone enrichment, and require independent ownership and handset evidence.

failures.risk: A detailing franchise or multi-location brand is treated as a one-person operator.
failures.mitigation: Segment known automotive brands and hold franchise/multi-location matches before forming an owner hypothesis.

iterations.hypothesis: The existing detailing relevance profile separates car-detailing businesses from adjacent automotive listings.
iterations.test: Five-case fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24 using classifyRelevance and franchiseBrand with no external calls or contact data: Precision Auto Detailing, Mobile Ceramic Coating, Neighborhood Car Wash, Tint World North, and Downtown Auto Repair.
iterations.observed: Detailing and ceramic coating classified core; tint and auto repair classified adjacent; Neighborhood Car Wash also classified core; Tint World was not brand-tagged. This checks classifier outputs only, not listing coverage, line type, owner identity, reachability, DNC, or delivery.
iterations.change: Treat the car-wash core result as a concrete relevance defect. Move car wash to adjacent or remove it and add a regression fixture; do not infer an owner or handset from the remaining classifications.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: Car-wash-only listings no longer qualify as core detailing. The parser requires a core match for this narrow cohort; detailing, ceramic coating and paint correction remain eligible.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Five synthetic classifier cases: Precision Auto Detailing core; Mobile Ceramic Coating core; Neighborhood Car Wash core; Tint World North adjacent and untagged; Downtown Auto Repair adjacent. Code audit only, with no live endpoint, phone, identity, or delivery measurement.

cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. The car-detailing brain's historical Anas rates use a different denominator and are not a per-clean cost for this workflow.

implementation.summary: Car-wash-only listings no longer qualify as core detailing. The parser requires a core match for this narrow cohort; detailing, ceramic coating and paint correction remain eligible. Original review: Car detailing is recognized and runs the Maps-first recipe-A route with published-business-contact and delivery gates. It has no owner-confirming adapter or separately recorded owner/handset evidence. The current detailing classifier incorrectly admits car washes as core, and its limited automotive franchise list does not tag the audited Tint World fixture.

nextMeasurement: After the classifier correction, add five synthetic discovery fixtures covering core detailing, ceramic coating, car-wash-only, tint/wrap-only, and auto-repair-only rows; verify only core detailing proceeds and that franchise tagging is reviewed. A later authorized outcome pilot must separately measure published-contact line type, DNC/TCPA, reachability, reached owner, ownership evidence, handset evidence, and delivery.
